ruleset.name: Test anti-patterns
ruleset.description: Anti-patterns in existing tests, for the find-test-anti-patterns skill.

rule.name: never_runs__IgnoredWithoutTest
rule.message: Marked @Ignore or @Disabled but has no test annotation: it never runs

rule.name: never_runs__JUnit3NameWithoutTest
rule.message: A public void test...() method with no test annotation, in a class that isn't a JUnit 3 test: it never runs

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[not(ExtendsList/ClassType[@SimpleName=('TestCase','AbstractDependencyInjectionSpringContextTests', 'AbstractTransactionalSpringContextTests','AbstractTransactionalDataSourceSpringContextTests','AbstractSpringContextTests', 'AbstractJpaTests','AbstractJUnit38SpringContextTests','AbstractTransactionalJUnit38SpringContextTests','GroovyTestCase', 'MockObjectTestCase')])] [.//MethodDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName=('Test','ParameterizedTest','RepeatedTest','TestFactory')] or ends-with(@SimpleName,'Test') or ends-with(@SimpleName,'Tests') or ends-with(@SimpleName,'TestCase')] /ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[starts-with(@Name,'test')][@Visibility='public'][@Void=true()][count(FormalParameters/*)=0] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName=('Test','ParameterizedTest','RepeatedTest','TestFactory','Ignore','Disabled')])]

rule.name: never_runs__JupiterSilentSkip
rule.message: A JUnit 5 or 6 test that is private, static or returns a value: JUnit skips it without a word

rule.name: swallows_failures__CatchesAssertionError
rule.message: A test catches AssertionError, Error or Throwable, which swallows its own failures

rule.name: no_real_assertion__BareAssertThatOrVerify
rule.message: assertThat(x) or verify(mock) with nothing after it checks nothing

rule.name: no_real_assertion__WeakAssertionsOnly
rule.message: The test's only assertions are assertNotNull, assertNull, isNotNull or assertTrue(true)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName=('Test','ParameterizedTest','RepeatedTest')]] [.//MethodCall[@MethodName=('assertNotNull','assertNull','isNotNull') or (@MethodName='assertTrue' and ArgumentList/BooleanLiteral)]] [not(.//MethodCall[(starts-with(@MethodName,'assert') and not(@MethodName=('assertNotNull','assertNull','assertTrue','assertThat'))) or @MethodName=('fail','verify','assertThrows')])] [not(.//MethodCall[@MethodName='assertTrue'][not(ArgumentList/BooleanLiteral)])] [not(.//MethodCall[@MethodName='assertThat'][parent::MethodCall or count(ArgumentList/*)>1])]

rule.name: no_real_assertion__ExpectedAnyException
rule.message: @Test(expected = Exception.class or Throwable.class) passes whatever goes wrong

rule.name: sleeps__Sleep
rule.message: Thread.sleep or TimeUnit sleep in test code

rule.name: order_dependent__FixedOrder
rule.message: The class fixes the order its tests run in

rule.name: mocks_everything__FiveOrMoreMocks
rule.message: The class has five or more mocks
